tools.name: compare_outbig_listings
tools.description: Read two to five active public OutBIG listings in one call and return the same verifiable fields for each. This does not rank product quality.

identities.description: Two to five distinct listing identities in the order they should be compared.

tools.name: explain_outbig_placement_options
tools.description: Explain paid listings, free promoted listings, and separate sponsor ads using OutBIG's current read-only stats and shared pricing rules. This never starts checkout or reserves a place.

tools.name: get_outbig_listing
tools.description: Read one active public OutBIG listing by identity key, domain, repository path, or @handle, including placement and ranks.

identity.description: A raw identity key such as website:example.com or x:alice, or a page slug such as example.com, github.com/owner/repo, or @alice.

tools.name: search_outbig_listings
tools.description: Search or list active public OutBIG marketplace listings through the existing read-only API. Rank is paid placement, not a quality score.

query.description: Optional 2-64 character search across listing name, resolved site title, and description.

categorySlug.description: Optional category slug from OutBIG's fixed catalogue.

countryCode.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AT or US.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return, 1-50.
